# C2PA Verify

> A browser-based tool for inspecting C2PA Content Credentials in media files and running structured conformance rubric checks.

C2PA Verify is built by the Content Authenticity Initiative. It processes files entirely in the browser using a WebAssembly build of c2pa-rs — no files are uploaded to any server.

## Who it's for

- **End users** who want to inspect Content Credentials embedded in images, video, audio, PDF, or other documents — seeing what claims were made, by whom, and when
- **Developers and implementers** building C2PA-compliant tools who want to validate their output and prepare for official conformance testing before submitting to the C2PA Conformance Program

## Capabilities

- Inspect C2PA manifests: assertions, actions, ingredients, claim generator info, and full provenance history
- Validate signing certificates against the official C2PA Trust List, Interim Trust List (ITL), and custom test certificates (session-only)
- Run conformance rubric checks (Conformance 0.1 / 0.2, Spec 2.2 / 2.4, Integrity, Signals) aligned with the C2PA Conformance Program
- Export crJSON reports — the canonical C2PA report format from c2pa-rs
- Support for sidecar `.c2pa` files (validate the manifest store without the original asset, or together for hash binding checks)
- Test Certificate Mode: load the C2PA Conformance Test Root and custom PEM certificates for validating pre-production implementations

## Technical notes

- All processing happens via WebAssembly (c2pa-rs compiled to wasm32); no server receives file content
- Trust lists are fetched at validation time from the official C2PA repository
- Reports include a git commit SHA and timestamp for reproducibility
